about.en: SK hynix bStock (SKHYB) is a tokenized share of SK hynix Inc. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xca750ef65f295bbecd685abf54e82caf297bdb61, backed 1:1 by the underlying shares held in segregated custody. It tracks the Nasdaq-listed SK hynix depositary receipt (SKHY), not the Korean common share, which trades at roughly seven times the price.
